rounds.text: Veedol Corporation is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a calculated margin of safety of 38.7% [E46]. The company demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, evidenced by a robust ROCE of 24.1% and a consistent median ROE of 18% to 19% over the last decade [E12, E26, E29]. This operational strength is backed by a conservative financial position, as the company is almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of only 0.04x [E37, E59]. Furthermore, shareholders are rewarded with a healthy 4.25% dividend yield, supported by a strong 73% payout ratio and full cash backing of reported profits [E4, E34, E61]. While the stock price has lagged, the fundamentals are clearly outpacing the market, as evidenced by recent 18% growth in both sales and profits [E17, E21, E56]. Conceded: the stock has suffered a 21% decline in price over the last year and currently sits below its 200-day moving average [E25, E50]. Despite this, the company’s ability to grow margins and maintain high returns in a sector with a positive tailwind suggests the current valuation is disconnected from its underlying performance [E30, E71, E73].
